summary: The project lock preserves metadata for distinct concurrent components and the persisted custom UI path now works. It still admits two competing additions to the same destination: both commands pass validation before acquiring the lock and both return success, contrary to the required actionable contention error.

findings.summary: Revalidate the add/upgrade plan after acquiring the project lock, so a competing operation targeting the same component fails rather than silently reapplying it.
findings.evidence: Two concurrent `company-angular add button` calls both returned code 0 and reported success. The second plan was created before the first wrote button.ts; locking only applyAdd serializes the stale plans instead of rejecting the second destination conflict.
